state: source_only_uncompiled; build and native execution require separate review/authorization
scope: Explicit reducer 8 or 9 only; original and paired MP-mass candidate; unchanged historical model, repair, numerators and native precision guards.

initial_native_phase.purpose: Bounded fixedQP input/transport and amplitude diagnostics; no host stability acceptance claim

later_checked_phase_requires_review.settings: Same original/candidate × 8/9 on the same two inputs, CTModeRun=-1. Preserve all actual direction, FPE and accuracy tests. If DP succeeds and QP is not entered, mark checked QP unqualified. Do not call fixed mode 4 checked, even when FORCE_STABILITY_CHECK is true. Any synthetic DP-rejection trigger needs a new, explicitly reviewed source change.

capture_required_before_later_native_lau: Original input P and actual repaired C/MP_P as exact binary128 bytes, identical across original/candidate/reducers.
Current MP mass argument bytes, DP square bytes, new QP square bytes, cyclic and CT5 permutation for all reached groups.
Per-group adapter-entry PL, masses and rank, and prepared native shifts, invariant matrix and scale; distinguish common C from backend preprocessing.
Numerator/UseQPIntegrand setting, model-update sequence, cards and native identities.
Finite/single/double coefficients, Born normalization, status, host estimated accuracy, FPE flags, native failures and actual DP/QP usage.
Initial/steady cache boundaries and stability-check separation; no changed cache policy.
accuracy_policy: Ordinary target 1e-8/regression 3e-6; retain all threshold refusals/disagreements. Reducer agreement and consistent masses alone do not certify a conditioned threshold amplitude. Require existing host acceptance plus independent analytic-pole/stability evidence before any accuracy claim.

unchanged_scale_policy.classification: Separate pre-existing cross-backend difference, not corrected by this mass-only prototype.

quiet_lane: Root assigns CPU/window; no timing/performance claim
remaining_source_work_before_execution: A matched bounded observer/driver must be frozen and independently reviewed before compiler/native launch; the copied historical check is not qualified for the checked phase.
